Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live"

SPECIFICATION FOR SCISSORS, DENTAL No. 
STRAIGHT AND CURVED ON FLAT 



1. Scope — Dimensions and requirements of dental scissors, No. I, straight and curved on flat. 

2. Shape and Dimensions 




SECTION XX 
ON ONE BLADE

riO 



ion 



M 2 SCREW 

CURVED ON FLAT

120 



f* 



FINGER LOOP No. 1 



All dimensions in millimetres. 
FIG. I SCISSORS, DENTAL, No. I, STRAIGHT AND CURVED ON FLAT 

2.1 The screw used shall be slotted raised cheese head pattern as shown in Fig. 2. The profile of the screw 
thread shall conform to IS: 4218 (Part I )- 1968*. The thread shall be of such length as to allow sufficient 
shank for proper bearing surface and to adequately secure component parts of the scissors with proper 
tension for cutting. The screw shall retain proper position after setting without binding or loosening during 
the use. The screw end may be left projecting up to 0'5 mm* 



*ISO metric screw threads: Part I Basic and design profiles.

2.2 Finger Loop-The finger loop shall be properly shaped and size shall conform to Size No. I of 12 of 
Section 5 of IS: 3642-1966*. 

3. Mate rial -As given in 2 of IS : 428 I- 1967|. 

4. Workmanship and Finish -As given in 4 of IS : 428 1- 1 967|. 

5. Hardness— The scissors shall be hardended and tempered to 550 to 600 HV. 

6. Tests 

6.1 Performonce - As given in 6. 1 of IS: 428 l-1967-f. 

6.2 Corrosion Resistance- As given in 6.4 of IS : 428 I- I967J, 

7. Marking-Each scissors shall be legibly and indelibly marked with the number of the instrument, 
manufacturer's name, initials or trade-mark, letters 'SS' and the country of manufacture. 

7.1 /$/ Certification Marking- Details available from Indian Standards Institution, New Delhi I.
